train.pooling_rule: Ordered contiguous bins over valid non-padding source tokens spanning the full valid sequence, including its final state. Prompt-format tokens are included. If the requested prefix is longer than the valid sequence, bins repeat the nearest valid token.
train.prompt_format: PFML3 translation request via the official source chat template, Japanese question only
